newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco to buy transparent ballot boxes.
newsitem.headline: Morocco to buy transparent ballot boxes.

text.p: Morocco plans to purchase 60,000 transparent ballot boxes for the legislative elections scheduled for the second half of 1997, an interior ministry official said on Saturday.
The move was an apparent answer to demands by opposition parties for "fair and transparent elections," a Moroccan political analyst said.
The previous 1993 legislative elections were denounced by the opposition, which alleged the results were manipulated.
King Hassan earlier said elections would take place this year in order to set up a bicameral parliament and give larger powers to regions.
The opposition, represented by a group of four parties, has 125 seats in the existing 333-seat parliament.
